notes.title: Survive the Outbreak – Plague: London 1665 is Now Available!
notes.content:
Dear Players,

The wait is over! Step into the grim and perilous world of [b]Plague: London 1665[/b], now officially released on Steam, Epic and GoG!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2225010/Plague_London_1665/

Set during the devastating Bubonic Plague outbreak in 1665, this pixel art RPG plunges you into the heart of overcrowded and disease-ridden London. As a body collector, graveyard keeper, and family provider, your survival depends on your ability to navigate these treacherous streets.

[h3]🎮 Get Plague: London 1665 now and face the outbreak head-on![/h3]

Will you risk it all to keep the city clean and your family fed, or will you become another victim of the deadly plague?

[h3]Collect bodies from the river and streets:[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39691164/f6d0e2ecf77e545fdbda4175c452cf07c20cdd02.gif[/img]

[h3]Transport them:[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39691164/e6620042ebf8ae90bba60248681e03bf4d3d9f9d.gif[/img]

[h3]Bury them:[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39691164/d6c6eed1e2f8e5274b740a2d22a5f7a4c94f5a4b.gif[/img]

In Plague: London 1665, every choice matters:

[list]
[*] Collect and Bury: Brave the streets as you collect the bodies of the deceased and give them a proper burial while avoiding infection.
[*] Scavenge and Trade: Resources are scarce. Find ways to gather supplies and barter with other survivors in this unforgiving environment.
[*] Meet NPCs: Engage with a diverse cast of characters, each with their own stories and agendas, as you make critical decisions that will shape the outcome of the game.
[*] Survive: Balance the needs of the city, your family, and yourself in a world where every move could mean life or death.
[/list]

With its blend of historical accuracy and intense gameplay, Plague: London 1665 offers a unique and immersive experience of one of history’s darkest times. The city’s fate is in your hands – will you survive?

Don't forget to share your experiences with us and leave a review! Your feedback is invaluable as we continue to improve and expand the game. Stay tuned for upcoming updates and announcements.

May luck be on your side in the streets of London.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2225010/Plague_London_1665/

notes.title: Unveiling New Realms and Resolving the Shadows of the Past
notes.content:
In this update, we've resolved a peculiar graphical anomaly that would, on rare occasions, cause certain characters' shadows to appear stretched and distorted when transitioning between outdoor and indoor environments. We understand that this could break the immersion and wanted to ensure a seamless visual experience for all players. With this issue fixed, you can now enjoy a consistently captivating journey through the magical realms of Rising Mist.

[h3]🌟 Explore a New Adventure:[/h3] As a special treat, we've enhanced the main menu. Look out for a new option that allows you to embark on a sneak peek of our upcoming project in development, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2225010/Plague_London_1665/]Plague: London 1665[/url]! . Step into the chilling streets of 17th-century London during the Great Plague. It's a chance to experience history like never before.

We're grateful for your continued support and feedback, which help shape the world of Rising Mist. Stay tuned for more exciting updates, and may your adventures within our games be legendary!

[b]Also note that Rising Mist is now available on the Epic Store.[/b]

[b][h2][h2]May the mists guide your path![/h2][/h2][/b]

notes.title: Survive the Plague: London 1665 - Wishlist Now on Steam!
notes.content:
[h2]Wishlist our new game[/h2]

Introducing "Plague: London 1665," an upcoming RPG pixel art game set during one of the most devastating pandemics in history. The game puts you in the shoes of a body collector and graveyard keeper, tasked with keeping the city of London clear of corpses and giving the deceased a proper burial.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2225010/Plague_London_1665/

With the Bubonic Plague outbreak in full swing, resources are scarce and competition for them is fierce. You must balance the need to provide for your family with the risk of contracting the deadly disease. Navigate the treacherous streets of London, scavenging for resources and trading with other survivors, all while avoiding the disease that threatens to claim thousands of lives.

As you progress through the game, you'll encounter a variety of NPCs, each with their own story and agenda. Every decision you make will have a significant impact on the outcome of the game. Will you prioritize the well-being of the city, the needs of your family, or your own survival?

"Plague: London 1665" offers a unique and immersive experience of being a body collector during a time of crisis, with a focus on historical accuracy and intense gameplay. We invite you to visit our Steam page to wishlist the game and stay updated on its development. Get ready to risk your life to clear out the streets, all for a hefty paycheck and the well-being of the city.

Wanted to remind you all that Rising Mist is less than a month shy of its release date and we are thrilled!
Most of the work is done and for the past weeks we have mainly focused on testing.

[b]Finishing testing:[/b]
As Rising Mist is all about the story and the experience, we had to replay the game many (many) times in order to be certain that the entire story lines up correctly and everything works.
More and more it became clear that Rising Mist is a completely story driven, visual novel/RPG and we are excited to hear your feedback after the release.

Please note if you have a gaming channel (YouTube, Twitch, Twitter, FB... or anything related to gaming) and would want to feature Rising Mist, we would be utterly grateful to you... or just please share this post, amongst your community or friends, this would also help us (if you like Rising Mist ocfurse).

notes.title: Items – Devlog #10
notes.content:
[h1]Items in Rising Mist[/h1]
For this devlog episode we have decided to dig into items that you can stumble upon in Occoterra, one way or another. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39691164/b0c062ebf2ba61603aa9f212802f30383465fce5.jpg[/img]

As you might remember we talked about crafting in our Devlog #3 and how individual items can create a new item. As that Devlog was titled Crafting in naturally left out all of the items that are not generated with a crafting process and this is what we want to talk about today.

If you missed Devlog #3 here is the link:
https://steamcommunity.com/app/1514610

In Rising Mist you can come by non-crafted items by just looking around and finding them in nature, lets say for example a Goblin Eye Flower.

notes.title: Roadmap and relevant dates
notes.content:
[h1][b]Roadmap and relevant dates[/b][/h1]

For this Steam post we decided to talk about the current state of Rising Mist. 
What is done what still needs to be developed, where are we test wise and try to work out a very rough date for the release of Rising Mist.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39691164/508e70a667ba36f1d2a2e3f304dd347c66484ba5.jpg[/img]

We have been working on this game for a bit over a year now and everything is coming along nicely development wise. So we don’t expect any major hiccups (hopefully this will not jinx it). ːsteamhappyː
Roughly speaking about 80-85% of the games mechanics are done, implemented and tested internally.
Also about 70-75% of the story and events surrounding it are currently implemented and working.
We are generally satisfied with the progress that we made and are confident that we will be able to determine a exact release date in the next 30-60 days.

While the game is mostly done, we don’t want to rush it as we want to invest as much time as needed into testing the game before determining a release date. As our primary goal is to have a decent and bug-free version on the release date, all planned features included.

Currently we are working on populating Occoterra, finishing up designs for Steam Achievements and adjusting the Save and Load system. Populating Occoterra and finishing the Steam Achievement designs will probably be completed by the end of next week.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39691164/30925d6a277bb41118f0813633d7a314b6d3e8a2.jpg[/img]

As you can see from this post we are unable to determine a 100% release date right now, but a very unofficial date that we are working towards is November 2021 but depends on the end user testing that we plan to host before announcing the release date. So if we would not be satisfied with the results from that test event we would in that case release the game in February 2022. Generally speaking these are the 2 date we are working towards so not very far away. :)

Hopefully you are looking forward to the release date.
If so please hit the Wishlist button to stay update on further news about Rising Mist.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39691164/c9f63c457cdd14fe3c79ebe8625937f57e0df92e.gif[/img]

Thank you for reading.

notes.title: Combat – Devlog #8
notes.content:
[h1]Combat in Rising Mist[/h1]
Today we want to talk about the combat mechanics in Rising Mist.
Below you can find a short video of how the corrent battle mechanics looks like. In this particular video the player is casting a spell on his opponent and therefore disabling has ability to react and after that we launches and lands a attack.

[previewyoutube=ZJUw4ukA4hk;full][/previewyoutube]
[i]Note, this is a video from the work environment and is not the final result.[/i]

Battles in Rising Mist are very common as bandits wait patiently for you to cross their path and other creatures just lurk in the shadows and prepare for your arrival. 
Therefore it is alway wise to have a few Health Potions, some Stunny Mist Potions and even maybe a Anti Magic Elixir in your pocket, this way you are able to have a advantage over your opponent yet that does not mean you will automatically defeat your opponent.

Key elements to succeeding in combat are your weapons, swords for attack and shields for defense. A important role plays also your experience level. If you are for example equipped with a very strong sword and a very strong shield but your experience level is low, while your opponents attack and defense gear is low but his experience level is high, you would have a hard time defeating such an opponent even with potions. It's not impossible but it is difficult.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39691164/30925d6a277bb41118f0813633d7a314b6d3e8a2.jpg[/img]

While journeying through Occoterra you will slowly but steadily encounter more and more powefull opponents so take every opportunity to train your skills, improve your experiance and do not pass on a good sword or sheild offer.

Keep in mind Occoterra is lawless and if bandits defeat you in battle, they will surely not pass the opportunity to robb you as well.
